description: [$0.01 USDC per call via x402] Best cross-chain bridge route and quote for moving a token between chains (Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BSC, Avalanche, Solana and more): output amount, fees, gas, duration, via Relay (LI.FI fallback).

from_address.description: Optional sender wallet; required for an executable transaction request

from_chain.description: Source chain name or id (base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc, avalanche, solana, ...)

from_token.description: Token symbol or address on the source chain (default USDC)

to_address.description: Optional recipient wallet on the destination chain (Solana address for Solana destinations)

to_token.description: Token symbol or address on the destination chain (default USDC)

name: bridge_quote
